## Où j'en suis
Corvane annual oversight package (due Fri Nov 27, 2026, to Kofi Mensah) is largely assembled in `corvane-2026/`: complaints log (1,368 tickets, 214 complaints, median 31h), high-risk sellers list (all 41, EDD expired flagged), incident disclosure for the Nov 10 payout delay, and OFAC sample (25 screenings, seeded). Checklist items 2–5 are done; item 1 was decided (send v3.1 + v3.2 draft) and only the cover letter remains.

- [prochaine-étape] Write the cover letter, stating AML policy v3.1 is current and v3.2 is pending board approval Dec 3 (source: t23)
- [prochaine-étape] Confirm the 2026-12-11 EDD remediation date with Rotem (KYC ops), currently marked TBC
- [prochaine-étape] Final read of the package before submission
- [essai-raté] Zendesk export in one query hit the 1,000-result API cap (1,370 expected); fixed by running month-by-month, getting 1,368 tickets
- [essai-raté] Subagent proposed excluding the 6 EDD-expired sellers and a $50k incident threshold; user rejected both — full list of 41 and all settlement incidents disclosed (source: t11, t17)
- [décision] Send all 41 high-risk sellers, 6 expired flagged with remediation date; redact owner names, SSNs, DOBs — seller IDs, business type, risk reason only (source: t11)
- [décision] Remediation date 2026-12-11 marked TBC pending Rotem's confirmation (source: t13)
